ModMetaData.name: Aragorn – Armee der Toten (v0.37.2)
ModMetaData.author: Aragorn Mod Project
ModMetaData.description:
DEUTSCH — Aragorn – Armee der Toten
Rette Aragorn, schmiede Andúril neu und befreie 13 Geisterkrieger in einer zusammenhängenden Questreihe. Beschwöre eine Geisterarmee mit sechs Klassen, nutze den Königlichen Befehl, mächtige Blitze, Andúrils Rundumschlag und Aragorns EMP-Sturm. Gegnerstärke, Geisterrüstung und Fähigkeiten sind einstellbar.
ENGLISH — Aragorn – Army of the Dead
Rescue Aragorn, reforge Andúril, and release 13 spectral warriors in a connected quest campaign. Summon an army across six classes and wield the King's Command, devastating lightning strikes, Andúril's sweeping attack, and Aragorn's EMP Storm. Adjust quest difficulty, spirit armor, and abilities in the mod settings.
v0.37.2 | RimWorld 1.6 | FIX: all six quest structures now prepare their entire footprint (plus clearance margin), removing old mountain rocks, thick roofs, ruins, vegetation and impassable terrain before a single quest wall is constructed. Every essential wall and door is validated after placement: incomplete buildings cause a clear error and quest retry instead of an invisible/missing fortress. The earlier v0.37.1 Harmony gizmo fix and all six class quests remain intact. | HOTFIX: restores all Aragorn gizmos and ghost-trial button after the Anduril forge. Fixes wrong Harmony result type for building deconstruction, and adds a regression check to protect the working forge-to-quest transition. Other v0.37 features retained. | Six different class trials, thirteen oath sarcophagi: 3 sword, 3 archer, 2 bombardier, 2 axe, 2 captain, 1 king. They remain intact when opened and are immune to damage, lightning and demolition during the trial. Each class has its own objective: three tomb combats, three guarded archer towers, lightning rituals, two protected 1v1 duels, three siege waves and a royal three-wave lightning finale. Sealing state is persisted in saves. Old active quests retain legacy completion rules; completed unlocks are not reset. Existing graphics, weapons and Ghost King gizmo remain unchanged. Royalty and Biotech remain optional; Harmony, Profaned, Divine Order and Vanilla Expanded Framework remain required.
